test_cases.description: CalloutBox must render arbitrary children content, not just hardcoded text — verifies the component actually passes through children ReactNodes
test_cases.input_description: A gotcha callout with unique nested JSX children not seen in visible tests
assertions: children content appears in the rendered output
container has border styling for gotcha type

test_cases.description: CalloutBox title rendering must work for any non-empty string, not just titles used in visible tests
test_cases.input_description: A warning callout with a novel title string containing special characters
assertions: heading element contains the exact novel title text

test_cases.description: CalloutBox should not render a heading element when title prop is undefined (not just empty string)
test_cases.input_description: A tip callout with title prop omitted (undefined)
assertions: no heading element is present in the DOM

test_cases.description: CalloutType enum must be case-sensitive — uppercase variants like 'Gotcha' or 'WARNING' must be rejected
test_cases.input_description: CalloutBox with type='Gotcha' (capitalized)
assertions: component throws or displays error for non-lowercase type variant

test_cases.description: CalloutType validation must reject strings that are close to valid variants but not exact matches
test_cases.input_description: CalloutBox with type='warn' (substring of 'warning')
assertions: component throws or displays error for 'warn' type

test_cases.description: Each CalloutType must produce a visually distinct icon — implementation cannot use the same icon for all types
test_cases.input_description: Render all three callout types and compare their icon elements
assertions: gotcha icon differs from warning icon
warning icon differs from tip icon

test_cases.description: CodeBlock must render the actual code prop text, not a hardcoded string matching visible test fixtures
test_cases.input_description: A unique code string not used in any visible test: 'kubectl get pods --namespace=kube-system -o wide'
assertions: the exact novel code string appears in the rendered output

test_cases.description: Copy button must pass the exact code prop to clipboard.writeText for any code string, not just visible test values
test_cases.input_description: CodeBlock with a unique multi-line code string, then click copy
assertions: clipboard.writeText called with exact multi-line code string

test_cases.description: CodeBlock title must be rendered as visible text above the code area for any title value
test_cases.input_description: CodeBlock with a novel title string 'Deployment Script v2'
assertions: title text 'Deployment Script v2' appears in the rendered output

test_cases.description: CodeBlock should not render a title element when title prop is omitted or empty
test_cases.input_description: CodeBlock with code but no title prop
assertions: no title element is rendered above the code block

test_cases.description: CodeBlock should treat whitespace-only code as valid (non-empty) since it contains characters
test_cases.input_description: CodeBlock with code='   ' (spaces only)
assertions: component renders without error
code content is present

test_cases.description: CodeBlock must accept and use arbitrary language identifiers beyond the default 'bash'
test_cases.input_description: CodeBlock with language='typescript' and TypeScript code
assertions: component renders successfully
code text is visible

test_cases.description: VersionBadge must display the exact version string passed, not a hardcoded value matching visible tests
test_cases.input_description: VersionBadge with version='4.7.2-rc.1'
assertions: text content contains '4.7.2-rc.1'
element has rounded-full class

test_cases.description: VersionBadge should render the label prop alongside or near the version string when provided
test_cases.input_description: VersionBadge with version='2.0.0' and label='Release'
assertions: version text '2.0.0' is present
label text 'Release' is present or version is displayed

test_cases.description: VersionBadge must accept any non-empty string as version, including a single character
test_cases.input_description: VersionBadge with version='1'
assertions: renders without error
text content includes '1'
has rounded-full class

test_cases.description: VideoEmbed must correctly convert watch URLs with additional query params (e.g., t= timestamp) to embed format
test_cases.input_description: VideoEmbed with url='https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abc123XYZ90&t=120'
assertions: iframe is rendered
iframe src contains youtube embed path with video ID

test_cases.description: VideoEmbed should accept youtu.be short URLs as valid YouTube URLs
test_cases.input_description: VideoEmbed with url='https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ'
assertions: iframe is rendered or URL is accepted without invalid_youtube_url error

test_cases.description: VideoEmbed iframe title must reflect the actual title prop value, not a hardcoded default
test_cases.input_description: VideoEmbed with title='My Custom Tutorial' and valid YouTube URL
assertions: iframe title attribute equals 'My Custom Tutorial'

test_cases.description: VideoEmbed must reject non-YouTube video URLs even from legitimate video platforms
test_cases.input_description: VideoEmbed with url='https://vimeo.com/123456789'
assertions: component throws or shows error for Vimeo URL

test_cases.description: VideoEmbed must reject URLs that contain 'youtube' but are not valid video URLs
test_cases.input_description: VideoEmbed with url='https://youtube.com/results?search_query=cats'
assertions: component rejects youtube search URL as invalid

test_cases.description: Sidebar must render NavLinks in the exact order of the routes array, not sorted or shuffled
test_cases.input_description: Sidebar with 3 routes in a specific order: Z-route first, A-route second, M-route third
assertions: NavLinks appear in DOM order matching input array order

test_cases.description: Each NavLink 'to' attribute must exactly match the corresponding RouteEntry.path, not a derived or modified path
test_cases.input_description: Sidebar with routes containing paths with varying patterns like '/foo/bar' and '/baz'
assertions: each link href matches the exact path from the route entry

test_cases.description: Sidebar must work correctly with a single-element routes array, not just hardcoded for multi-route scenarios
test_cases.input_description: Sidebar with exactly 1 route entry
assertions: exactly 1 link is rendered
nav element is present

test_cases.description: Sidebar must dynamically render links for any number of routes, including the full 13-route manifest
test_cases.input_description: Sidebar with 7 route entries
assertions: exactly 7 links are rendered

test_cases.description: Sidebar root must be a semantic <nav> HTML element, not just a div with role='navigation'
test_cases.input_description: Sidebar with standard routes
assertions: root element tagName is NAV

test_cases.description: PageLayout content area must use flex-1 or equivalent to fill remaining horizontal space
test_cases.input_description: PageLayout with standard routes and children
assertions: content area element has flex-1 or grow class

test_cases.description: PageLayout must actually pass routes to its internal Sidebar component, not render a static sidebar
test_cases.input_description: PageLayout with 3 custom routes and verify links appear
assertions: all 3 route labels appear as navigation links in the sidebar area

test_cases.description: PageLayout must render the actual children passed, not hardcoded content
test_cases.input_description: PageLayout with unique child content 'Unique-Goodhart-Content-XYZ'
assertions: text 'Unique-Goodhart-Content-XYZ' is present in the rendered output

test_cases.description: All components must be available as both named exports from their files — barrel index must re-export all named components
test_cases.input_description: Import from the barrel index and verify named exports exist
assertions: CalloutBox is a function
CodeBlock is a function
VersionBadge is a function
VideoEmbed is a function
Sidebar is a function
PageLayout is a function

test_cases.description: CalloutBox must render multiple children elements, not just a single text child
test_cases.input_description: CalloutBox with multiple JSX children (paragraph + list)
assertions: all child elements are rendered in the callout body
